from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection, including its title and what other provided papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    cites_from_collection: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
